findings.evidence: The closing section reads 'About this page' / 'Its study id, …, is the name of the folder…'. The pronoun has no clear antecedent in the paragraph. 'This page's study id' would be plainer for a newcomer.

summary: The code and data changes do all four requested fixes, but the verdict is fail on one criterion I can't confirm: no producer report listing the commands it ran is visible to me (criterion 7). The four fixes: (1) the Limits findings are renumbered to f1, f2, f3 in findings.json, so the fix is in the data; (2) the study-id paragraph moved from the header to an 'About this page' note after the claims; (3) a new plain sentence saying what firstmate is, with claim links, comes before 'Words used first'; (4) Next steps now include `./setup.sh` and `athena ask "add a changelog"`, both matching the README Quick start. Every changed file is on the deliverables list, and no claims or governance files changed. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test runs passed. I ran `cargo run -p xtask -- site` and it succeeded. I couldn't read the page it wrote: it lands outside the working directory and the policy hook refused access. So I checked the rendered page through the new integration test the_rendered_page_has_the_newcomer_fixes, which builds the real page and checks all four fixes; it passed, as did the 28 site unit tests. The fix for criterion 7 is for the producer's report to list its commands, including the site rebuild.
